### Day 27: 1 Samuel 21:10–15
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-27-1-samuel-21-1015.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 21:10-15
Points:
- Seeking refuge in Gath, David became terrified after the Philistines recognized him.
- He used quick street-smarts to feign insanity, scratching gates and drooling on his beard.
- King Achish dismissed David because superstitious pagans feared harming madmen.
- Although David relied on wit and personality, his difficult journey was just beginning.
- Believers are challenged to rest in God's presence no matter how chaotic life becomes.

### David on the Run
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/david-on-the-run
Passage: 1 Samuel 21:9
Points:
- Fleeing from Saul's murderous hostility, David arrived in Nob in need of food and weapons.
- The Lord provided sustenance through consecrated bread and armed him with Goliath's sword.
- When trapped in Philistine territory at Gath, David escaped by feigning madness.
- Whatever the morality of David's deception, God protected him from harm.
- God's purpose to establish David could not be thwarted, assuring believers of His providential care.
